title: Rules.
bodyText: The authority may adopt under chapter 91 all rules necessary to carry out the purpose of this part, including rules relating to determining preference among applicants for state rent supplements.
bodyHtml: [§356D-156]  Rules.  The authority may adopt under chapter 91 all rules necessary to carry out the purpose of this part, including rules relating to determining preference among applicants for state rent supplements. [L 2006, c 180, pt of §2]
